Zanzibar & Tanzania Migration Calendar

Plan your trip around the Great Migration and other wildlife movements — the best times to visit for wildlife viewing.

Migration Overview

Understanding the Great Migration

Tanzania's Great Migration is one of nature's most spectacular events. While often associated with the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem, Zanzibar offers unique wildlife experiences year-round.

The Great Migration involves over 1.5 million wildebeest, zebra, and Thomson's gazelle moving in a circular pattern through the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem. The movement is driven by rainfall and grass growth, creating a dynamic calendar of wildlife viewing opportunities.

Monthly Migration Calendar

When to See the Migration

January - March

Southern Serengeti — Calving Season

  • Approximately 500,000 wildebeest calves are born
  • Predator activity is high (lions, cheetahs, hyenas)
  • Excellent predator viewing
  • Good time for Zanzibar beach extension

April - May

Western Serengeti — Long Rains Period

  • Animals move west and north
  • Some lodges close due to rains
  • Lower tourist numbers — better deals
  • Good bird watching

June - July

Northern Serengeti & Maasai Mara River Crossings

  • Iconic river crossings at Grumeti and Mara River
  • Highest concentration of wildlife
  • Peak tourist season
  • Best for photography

August - October

Masai Mara, Kenya

  • wildebeest cross into Kenya's Masai Mara
  • Dry season — excellent game viewing
  • Good time for Zanzibar beach holiday
  • Peak season — book early

November - December

Return South

  • Herds begin moving back to Serengeti
  • Short rains begin
  • Fewer tourists
  • Good value for safari and beach
Zanzibar Wildlife Highlights

Zanzibar's Own Wildlife Calendar

Turtle Nesting

January - March: Green and hawksbill turtles nest on Zanzibar's beaches, particularly Nungwi and Jambiani.

  • Night turtle watching tours available
  • Support conservation efforts
  • See hatchlings make their way to the sea

Dolphin Season

Year-round: Bottlenose and humpback dolphins are commonly sighted.

  • Best viewing: Early morning trips
  • Kizimkazi (south coast) is the prime location
  • Ethical dolphin watching guidelines apply

Humpback Whales

July - October: Humpback whales migrate through Zanzibar channels.

  • Whale watching tours available
  • Possible to see breaching and calf behavior
  • Combine with safari and beach

Bird Migration

November - April: Migratory birds pass through Zanzibar.

  • Excellent for bird watching
  • Many species from Europe and Asia
  • Nungwi and Jambiani are prime spots
Best Times to Visit

Combining Safari & Zanzibar

Safari First, Then Zanzibar

Many travelers do a mainland safari followed by a Zanzibar beach relaxation.

  • June - October: Best overall — dry season, great migration
  • January - February: Great for calving season, less crowded
  • Book safari lodges well in advance for peak season

Zanzibar First, Then Safari

Relax on the beach then explore Tanzania's wildlife.

  • July - October: Whale watching combined with safari
  • November - December: Lower rates, good value
  • Perfect for honeymooners wanting beach then adventure

Monthly Summary

January - March: Calving season, good birding, turtle nesting

April - May: Low season, good deals, some lodges closed

June - July: River crossings, peak season

August - October: Masai Mara crossing, best wildlife viewing

November - December: Return south, good value, birding
